== Summary ==
Games at a long table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
* '''Image:''' downscaled to 1920×1080 (JPEG quality 90) from the 1920×1080 forum attachment.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1357864#p1357864 post 1357864] in topic 79418 (the rest of his 2021 Worlds photos, cross-posted from Facebook), by Thekillerkiwi, 2021-10-31. Original attachment name: P1060107.jpg; forum attachment id 15250. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005520/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t79418.html Internet Archive]
